summary: Added GET /api/v1/links/{code}/qr, returning a generated SVG QR code for the canonical short URL. Registered a framework-only QR generator and kept unknown-link errors on the existing ProblemDetails path.
rationale: The endpoint reuses the existing link lookup and BaseUrl behavior and makes no persistence or schema changes. The QR encoder avoids new package dependencies and the previous implicit-variable declaration compile failure.
content: Implemented the QR endpoint and registered a deterministic SVG generator. The encoder supports QR versions 1–10 at error-correction level L; payloads beyond that supported capacity fail rather than being truncated.
